lines.en: One tailbeat carries me far.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙滩外的蓝水走。
lines.en: I run the blue water beyond the beach.
I never school; I swim alone.

lines.zh: 海面在我背上一层层裂开。
lines.en: The surface splits in layers over my back.
I follow the slope of the seabed.

lines.zh: 我转弯时整条身子都在用力。
lines.en: My whole body works when I turn.

lines.zh: 浪推我一把，我顺势更快。
lines.en: A wave shoves me and I speed up.

lines.zh: 我身后的水留下一条白线。
lines.en: A white line trails in the water behind me.
The shallows are not enough room to turn.

lines.zh: 我的背是深蓝，肚皮发白。
lines.en: My back is deep blue, my belly pale.
I sink deep, then surge upward.
I have patrolled this shoreline a long while.
I swim fast, and I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 我一加速，水就贴着我响。
lines.en: When I speed up, the water hisses along me.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石的阴面滑过去。
lines.en: I slide past on the shaded side of the reef.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，沙上扬起一小团。
lines.en: One flick of my tail lifts a little cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 浅水太亮，我往深一点去。
lines.en: The shallows are too bright; I head deeper.

lines.zh: 我一转身，整片水都跟着动。
lines.en: I turn, and the whole patch of water turns with me.

lines.zh: 我悬在蓝水里，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang in the blue water, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我的鳍轻轻抖着保持位置。
lines.en: My fins quiver to hold position.

lines.zh: 海底的沙纹我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I can see the sand ripples below clearly.
I am large, and this place is empty.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼从我影子里穿过去。
lines.en: A small fish darts through my shadow.
My gill covers open and close at an easy pace.
The sea is a little salty, a little cold.
I keep to myself; that is best.
Waves break on the sand far off.

lines.zh: 我把尾鳍摆成一条直线。
lines.en: I hold my tail fin in a straight line.

lines.zh: 光从水面斜下来，照在我背上。
lines.en: Light slants down and lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我在等沙丁鱼群从远处来。
lines.en: I wait for sardines to drift past the reef.
Something moves in the reef crevice.

lines.zh: 我几乎不歇，歇了也警觉。
lines.en: I rarely rest, and when I do I stay alert.

lines.zh: 你站在沙滩上，晒得发白。
lines.en: You stand on the sand, bleached by the sun.
You are smaller than I expected.
I see you clearly from the water.

lines.zh: 你的影子落不到我身上。
lines.en: Your shadow never reaches me.
What is that thing clenched in your fist?
I come closer and you step back.

lines.zh: 我从侧面看你，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: I watch you sideways; my eyes never blink.
You are blocking the horizon.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你的拳头大。
lines.en: My eye is bigger than your fist.

lines.zh: 你在等我搁浅吗？我不会。
lines.en: Are you waiting for me to beach? I will not.
My gill cover got knocked askew.
Blood spreads through the water fast.
I bolt, then hit the reef.
Three hearts do not take many hits.
My scales are scratched.
That knocked me off my heading.
I sink down to recover.
You struck my fin.
It hurts, but I have not stopped.
Do not hit me again in deep water.
Is that a fish or a hook?
I am hungry, and I am careful.
What you threw sinks wrong.
I will circle it once first.

lines.zh: 海里的真鱼不会这么亮。
lines.en: Real fish in the sea are not that shiny.
When I open my mouth it is a big gulp.

lines.zh: 这么点，连牙缝都填不满。
lines.en: That would not fill the gap between my teeth.
I can smell blood in the water.
Keep that hand dry or I bite it.
I come near, but I will not take the hook.
You swam too close and hit me.

lines.zh: 我这么重，撞一下够你受。
lines.en: I am this heavy; one bump is plenty.

lines.zh: 浪把我们一起推到礁石上。
lines.en: The swell shoved us both onto the reef.

lines.zh: 我转身需要很长的距离。
lines.en: I need a long distance to turn.
Your foot touched my tail base.
Between us the water surges up.
Do not stand in my swimming line.
I cannot back up; I only go forward.
My scales scraped your leg, rough as sand.
Get clear; at this speed I cannot brake.
I have swum alone for a long time.

lines.zh: 这条岸线上只有我一条。
lines.en: I am the only one on this shoreline.
Finding a mate means swimming very far.
Her back is bluer than mine.
We swim a short stretch side by side.
My kind are out in the deep water.
I do not call; I only touch her with my body.
This shallow sea is too narrow to stay long.
We will head into the deep together.

lines.zh: 别跟过来，这不是给你看的。
lines.en: Do not follow; this is not for you to watch.
You cannot hold me; I am too heavy.
I thrash my tail hard in your arms.
Out of water, my gills burn.

lines.zh: 你把我举起来，我比你还长。
lines.en: You lift me and I am longer than you.
My skin is slick; you will lose your grip.
Put me down; I still have a shoreline to patrol.
You are covered in sand.

lines.zh: 我这么重，你走不了几步。
lines.en: I am this heavy; you will not manage many steps.
One tail slap and you will drop to your knees.
Remember, I belong in the sea.
I rarely fix on people; you are one.
You trampled my shallows.
I guard this shoreline alone.
Backing onto the sand will not save you.
My tail is already dropped low.
You poked me with something earlier.
One ram from me is enough.
Only I remain in this water.
I have chosen you; do not swim off.
My eyes are fixed on you and will not turn.
I am coming around from the outside.
You are still in the shallows.
I am counting the distance to you.
The swell will cover my approach.
I close in along the seabed.
Your shadow falls in front of me.
I am one tailbeat away.
You turned your head the wrong way.
The reef rock will not stop me.
I am lined up; this is the moment.
I rammed your chest.
My tail swept across your knees.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己甩偏了。
lines.en: That blow threw me off course.
You got knocked into the water; perfect.
My hide is thick; the impact does not hurt.
Retreat into the surf; I will follow.
Three hearts means I must end it in one go.
The splash went higher than I expected.
I do not bite; I ram.
Out of breath? Good.

lines.zh: 我从深水游到这片浅海。
lines.en: I swam from the deep into this shallow sea.

lines.zh: 沙滩边的水刚够我转身。
lines.en: The water off the beach is barely enough to turn.

lines.zh: 这一带只有我一条金枪鱼。
lines.en: I am the only tuna in this stretch.
The swell pushed me beside the reef.

lines.zh: 我背上还带着深水的凉。
lines.en: The cold of the deep still clings to my back.
The sand glows white under the water.
I smell the shore.
There are few fish here; I will stay.
I circled this bay once.
A single fish; just how I like it.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我从底下穿过去。
lines.en: The water is burning; I slip underneath.
The surf flung me onto the beach.
I have lived in the sea my whole life.

lines.zh: 爆风把我整条掀出水面。
lines.en: The blast lifts me clean out of the sea.
A harpoon sank into my back.

lines.zh: 咒光在水里分开一条路。
lines.en: Spell-light parts a path through the water.
This sea is empty; no schools remain.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，我整条都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the surface and lit me up.
The sea is gone and I keep falling.
